sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:27

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:27:1
items.html: BON, which is the clarification of the seven kings together with the posterior of AVI: This means from AA downward, and also in the seven lower Sefirot of Atik. But the GAR [first three] of Atik have nothing at all of the posterior of AVI and of Keter, and all the more so they have nothing of the ZAT of Nekudim, as written further on.
